characters.name: Shiva
characters.overall_description: The cosmic destroyer, ascetic yogi, and divine father of balance, embodying both creation and dissolution in his being.

visual_details.hair_style: Matted dreadlocks flowing down the back, tied in a topknot
visual_details.eye_color: Glowing icy blue with a vertical third eye on the forehead
visual_details.accessories: Snake coiled around neck, rudraksha beads, crescent moon on hair, Ganga flowing from head
visual_details.notable_features: Third eye glowing with cosmic fire, scar on chest from the return of the creation, aura of crackling energy

characters.name: The Nameless Being
characters.overall_description: A genderless, divine creation of Shiva born from his third eye, embodying cosmic balance and light.

visual_details.body_type: Lithe and ethereal, with glowing musculature beneath translucent skin
visual_details.hair_style: Flowing and weightless, like light in motion
visual_details.clothing_style: Celestial robes that shimmer like a nebula
visual_details.accessories: Orb of flame hovering over one palm, stream of stardust trailing steps
visual_details.notable_features: Body emits soft light, markings of balance etched across skin, dissolves into energy
